scripts.dev: npx concurrently --raw "npm --prefix api-evolution run dev:server" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.setup: node scripts/sync-env.js && npx concurrently --raw "npm --prefix api-evolution install" "npm --prefix backend install" "npm --prefix frontend install"
scripts.setup:db: node scripts/db-setup.js && cd api-evolution && node runWithProvider.js "npx prisma migrate dev --name init --schema=./prisma/postgresql-schema.prisma" && cd ../backend && npm run db:migrate -- --name init && npm run db:seed
